questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India guarantees the 'Protection of Life and Personal Liberty'?
questions.explanation: Article 21 states that 'No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.' It is one of the most fundamental articles in Part III and cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency under Article 359.

questions.question: By which Constitutional Amendment Act were the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 (frequently referred to as the 'Mini-Constitution' enacted during the Internal Emergency under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi) amended the Preamble of the Indian Constitution for the first and only time in history. It officially inserted three historic words: 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity', changing the description of India from a 'Sovereign Democratic Republic' to a 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic'.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of Baking Soda?
questions.explanation: Baking soda is chemically known as Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate (or Sodium Bicarbonate) with the chemical formula NaHCO3. Produced industrially via the Solvay process, it releases carbon dioxide gas upon heating or reaction with mild edible acids, causing dough to rise. By comparison: Na2CO3·10H2O is Washing Soda; Ca(OH)2 is Slaked Lime (calcium hydroxide); and CaOCl2 is Bleaching Powder (calcium oxychloride).

questions.question: Kaziranga National Park, celebrated worldwide for hosting two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses, is located in:
questions.explanation: Kaziranga National Park is a renowned UNESCO World Heritage Site situated along the fertile Brahmaputra River floodplains across Golaghat, Nagaon, and Sonitpur districts of Assam.
